raw.body:
# [2.0.0](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/compare/v1.0.1...v2.0.0) (2026-01-23)


### Bug Fixes

* **parser:** normalize token to lower case ([#85](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/issues/85)) ([aa11a07](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/commit/aa11a07f6feb60f4fe0084962bf5efdcc5c8bb6a)), closes [#1](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/issues/1)


### Features

* **extract:** allow to extract multiple expressions from string ([#87](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/issues/87)) ([7d0d29c](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/commit/7d0d29cf5a9be4bca547c650cec7dbd7976a5c72)), closes [#3](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/issues/3) [#81](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/issues/81)
* implement proper parsing (CST/AST/XML) ([#84](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/issues/84)) ([661687f](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/commit/661687f397b898ce7d907251931673827ef90f34))
* minimal Node.js version is now 16.14.0 ([24df0f0](https://github.com/swaggerexpert/arazzo-runtime-expression/commit/24df0f04e7e7eb20ebea1419411cdc34f3590540))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* **extract:** signature of extract function changed.
* this is a breaking change as the results that parser is producing has
radically diffrent shape and semantics.
* minimal Node.js version was bumped from 12.20.0 to 16.14.0
